source.snippet: When we try to update the email address for any user - say deploy user - it will send an email to us. But when we click the url and then click confirm the change button, it asks us to login. And since this is a new sandbox of course we don't have the password. And we can't reset the password as the email is not updated and it is still .invalid email. [Salesforce CI/CD admin, enterprise context, post-release breakage affecting deploy pipelines]

problem_statement: After a Salesforce platform release, newly spun-up sandboxes enter an unresolvable auth loop: the deploy-user email can't be confirmed without a password, and the password can't be reset without a confirmed email, blocking CI/CD pipelines until manual Salesforce support intervention.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and DevOps engineers at companies running CI/CD pipelines against Salesforce sandboxes
notes: Business context is clear: broken sandbox auth blocks release pipelines at companies that pay for Salesforce enterprise licenses. A scripted sandbox-bootstrap or post-refresh automation tool that resolves email/auth state could charge per-org or as a managed package. Paired with the GitHub Actions CI/CD auth failure item (https://salesforce.stackexchange.com/questions/439563/github-ci-cd-org-auth-failing), this suggests a recurring Salesforce DevOps tooling gap. Buyer: Salesforce admin/DevOps teams who already pay for Salesforce and SF DevOps tooling.
